cluster_inventory.tissue_condition: Breast, esophagus mucosa, esophagus muscularis, heart, lung, prostate, skeletal muscle, skin (frozen archived GTEx samples)
cluster_inventory.note: 43 broad cell classes reported; exact number of graph-based clusters not stated in main text.
74 fine cell categories reported; exact number of graph-based clusters not stated in main text.
14 distinct monocyte, macrophage, and dendritic cell subsets.

verifications.source_context: These included CD16+ monocytes, CD14+ monocytes, two transitional Mo/MΦ FCGR3Alow and Mo/MΦ FCGR3Ahigh populations...
verifications.reason: CD14+ monocytes is an annotated cell subset; CD14 is used in the subset name and displayed as a marker gene in Fig. 3B. Satisfies both marker identity and annotation use.

verifications.source_context: two transitional Mo/MΦ FCGR3Alow and Mo/MΦ FCGR3Ahigh populations with coexpression of both monocyte and macrophage markers
verifications.reason: FCGR3A is used to name and distinguish the Mo/MΦ FCGR3Alow subset; Fig. 3B shows it as a marker gene. Satisfies both criteria.

verifications.source_context: two transitional Mo/MΦ FCGR3Alow and Mo/MΦ FCGR3Ahigh populations with coexpression of both monocyte and macrophage markers
verifications.reason: FCGR3A is used to name and distinguish the Mo/MΦ FCGR3Ahigh subset; Fig. 3B shows it as a marker gene. Satisfies both criteria.

verifications.source_context: two additional macrophage subsets: MΦ LYVE1high and MΦ HLAIIhigh (Fig. 3B), where HLAII is HLA class II
verifications.reason: LYVE1 is used to name the MΦ LYVE1high subset and is shown as a marker gene in Fig. 3B. Satisfies both criteria.

verifications.source_context: notable exceptions included PPARGhigh lung macrophages, which were present only in lung
verifications.reason: PPARG is used in the subset name 'PPARGhigh lung macrophages', identifying this macrophage state. Satisfies marker identity and annotation use.

verifications.source_context: CD207/Langerin+ Langerhans cells, which were present only (97%) in skin and esophagus mucosa
verifications.reason: CD207 (Langerin) is used to name the Langerhans cell subset; Fig. 3B shows marker genes for Langerhans cells. CD207/Langerin resolves to CD207.

verifications.source_context: LAMs in creeping fat from Crohn’s intestine and atherosclerotic lesions were additionally characterized by higher expression of interleukin IL1B and multiple chemokines (CXCL8, CXCL3, CCL4)
verifications.reason: IL1B is described as a higher-expressed gene in LAMs under specific pathological contexts, but not presented as a marker used for LAM identification or annotation. It is a functional/state descriptive gene.

verifications.source_context: alveolar fibroblasts express myofibroblast markers (e.g., ACTA2; fig. S18D), they are distinct from previously reported myofibroblasts
verifications.reason: ACTA2 is referred to as a myofibroblast marker, not an alveolar fibroblast marker; used descriptively to compare with myofibroblasts, and is an external literature reference.

verifications.source_context: alveolar fibroblasts express myofibroblast markers (e.g., ACTA2; fig. S18D)
verifications.reason: ACTA2 is called a myofibroblast marker in passing, citing previous reports; myofibroblasts are not an annotated cell population in this study, and this is not used for annotation.

verifications.source_context: Fast myocytes specifically expressed the type 2 fiber marker MYH2 (FDR < 10−15 in cytoplasmic myonuclei)
verifications.reason: MYH2 is explicitly described as the type 2 fiber marker for fast myocytes and is concordant with previously reported markers used for fast/slow myocyte annotation (figs. S9C/D). Satisfies both criteria.

verifications.source_context: PIEZO2+/ITGA8+ alveolar fibroblasts may contribute to mechanosensing of alveolar tension
verifications.reason: PIEZO2 is part of a calcium signaling/actomyosin contractility program distinctively expressed by alveolar fibroblasts, but it is not presented as an annotation marker and was not used to define the cluster; appears in functional module discussion.

verifications.source_context: PIEZO2+/ITGA8+ alveolar fibroblasts may contribute to mechanosensing of alveolar tension
verifications.reason: ITGA8 is part of a basement membrane adhesion module enriched in alveolar fibroblasts, shown in expression module figures (Fig. 4F/G), not in the marker panel (Fig. 4B). Not presented as an annotation marker.

verifications.source_context: which so far has been mainly attributed to Piezo2+ sensory neurons in mice (111)
verifications.reason: Piezo2+ sensory neurons in mice are cited from reference (111) as an alternative explanation; sensory neurons are not an annotated cell type in this study, and the marker is only an external reference.

new_findings.source_context: These included CD16+ monocytes, CD14+ monocytes, two transitional Mo/MΦ FCGR3Alow and Mo/MΦ FCGR3Ahigh populations...
new_findings.reason: CD16+ monocytes are an annotated myeloid subset; CD16 (encoded by FCGR3A) is used in the subset name and shown as a marker gene in Fig. 3B.

new_findings.source_context: HLAIIhigh cells were enriched for immune-related processes and expressed higher levels of complement components APOE and C1QA, C1QB, and C1QC (Fig. 3B and fig. S16, C and D)
new_findings.reason: APOE is listed as a component of the HLAIIhigh macrophage marker panel in Fig. 3B, a figure explicitly showing marker genes associated with each subset.

new_findings.reason: C1QA is listed as a component of the HLAIIhigh macrophage marker panel in Fig. 3B.

new_findings.reason: C1QB is listed as a component of the HLAIIhigh macrophage marker panel in Fig. 3B.

new_findings.reason: C1QC is listed as a component of the HLAIIhigh macrophage marker panel in Fig. 3B.

new_findings.source_context: Alveolar fibroblasts also specifically expressed FGFR4 (Fig. 4B), which is essential for alveologenesis in mice (109)
new_findings.reason: FGFR4 is described as specifically expressed by alveolar fibroblasts and is shown in Fig. 4B, a figure of marker genes distinguishing tissue-enriched fibroblasts. Satisfies marker identity and annotation use.

new_findings.source_context: slow myocytes preferentially expressed type 1 fiber markers (36, 128) and disease genes MYH7 (FDR < 10−15 in cytoplasmic myonuclei) and PPARGC1A (FDR < 10−15 in regular myonuclei)
new_findings.reason: MYH7 is explicitly described as a type 1 fiber marker and is concordant with previously reported markers used to define slow myocytes. Satisfies both criteria.

new_findings.source_context: slow myocytes preferentially expressed type 1 fiber markers (36, 128) and disease genes MYH7 (FDR < 10−15 in cytoplasmic myonuclei) and PPARGC1A (FDR < 10−15 in regular myonuclei)
new_findings.reason: PPARGC1A is described alongside MYH7 as a type 1 fiber marker and disease gene expressed in slow myocytes; satisfies marker identity and annotation use.

issues.description: The exact number of graph-based clusters in the global analysis is not stated in the main text; only annotation labels (43 broad, 74 fine) are reported.

All included markers are from immune (CD14, FCGR3A, LYVE1, PPARG, CD207, APOE, C1QA/B/C) and muscle (MYH2, MYH7, PPARGC1A) cell types; none fall within the task's L2 Schwann or L4 neuroendocrine scope. This is not an exclusion criterion but reflects the paper's content.

task.paper_title: Single-nucleus cross-tissue molecular reference maps toward understanding disease gene function.
